summary: Full frontend + backend E2E verification of the EULA acceptance gate. Created a fresh throwaway attendee via super-admin API, logged in via UI, and exercised the whole 3-strikes-then-hard-block flow, plus a smoke check that an existing backfilled admin is not gated. All 8 features from the review request PASS.
features_verified: Fresh user (attendee) sees EULA modal (data-testid=eula-modal) immediately on first login on /dashboard — eula-content, eula-agree-btn, and eula-remind-later-btn all present; eula-hard-block-notice NOT present at decline_count=0. Placeholder text 'END USER LICENCE AGREEMENT — PLACEHOLDER…' rendered correctly.

Clicking 'Remind me later' fires POST /api/eula/decline → 200 {decline_count:1}, modal closes for the session, and does NOT reappear on client-side navigation within the same session (verified /meetings nav).
Modal reappears on FULL PAGE RELOAD when decline_count is 1 and 2 — persistence via server-side counter works.

After 3 total 'Remind me later' dismissals, on the 4th appearance the eula-remind-later-btn is REMOVED (count=0), eula-hard-block-notice is shown with copy 'You must accept this agreement to continue using 1two.one.', and both ESC key and backdrop click do NOT close the modal.
Clicking 'I Agree' calls POST /api/eula/accept, modal closes, and does NOT reappear on subsequent reloads (DB confirmed eula_accepted_version=1, decline_count reset to 0).

Existing backfilled admin (admin@supervision.com, eula_accepted_version=1) does NOT see the modal at all on /dashboard. /api/eula/current returns needs_acceptance=false, decline_count=0 for this user.

EulaGate does NOT render on /login even when the user is logged in with needs_acceptance=true would be true (PUBLIC_PATHS gate verified by navigating to /login while session cookie present — modal count=0).
No new console errors introduced by EulaGate. Only pre-existing /auth 401 noise on the login page (normal AuthContext bootstrap when unauthenticated).
critical_code_review_comments: EulaGate.js line 24 uses raw `/api` prefix relying on the Kubernetes ingress rewrite; axios.defaults.baseURL is set in AuthContext so this happens to work, but it's inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — consider aligning for clarity (non-blocking).

Hard-block-notice copy is only rendered once decline_count>=3, but if the accept POST fails the modal is re-shown with a still-hidden remind-later button (canDismiss is computed from stale eula.decline_count). Edge case only; not user-visible under normal use.

eula-modal-backdrop is a sibling div, not a click target overlay ABOVE the modal — clicking it programmatically has no dismiss handler, so 'no backdrop click close' requirement is satisfied by construction. Good.
test_credentials: Created & then deleted eula-test-1789757946@example.com / EulaTest123! (attendee, Test Company org). Used admin@supervision.com/Admin123!X (backfilled) for non-gated verification. Super-admin used for user provisioning via API.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created one attendee via POST /api/super-admin/orgs/{org_id}/users, cleaned up via DELETE at end. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Helper script /app/backend/tests/create_eula_test_user.py supports create/delete/show/reset_eula for future EULA tests. Note: super-admin-created users always have must_change_password=true — flip that off in DB before testing EulaGate directly, otherwise the /set-password redirect fires first (EulaGate correctly no-ops when must_change_password=true, tested via that gate).
